description: Composite TEM figure documenting the microstructure of three hot-rolled austenitic low-density steels (28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni, 15Mn5Ni), combining bright-field and dark-field micrographs with selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns. (b) is a bright-field TEM image of 28Mn5Ni with a 1 µm scale bar, yellow arrows marking B2 particles at γ-grain boundaries (caption gives ~300 nm). (c) is a bright-field TEM image of 15Mn5Ni with a 5 µm scale bar, yellow arrows pointing to large B2 stringers connecting across grains. (d) is a SAED pattern labelled ZA: [011]B2||[011]DO3 with a 10 nm⁻¹ scale bar; red circles enclose the extra DO3-type reflections labelled 311(D), 200(D) and 111(D), while a blue circle marks the 100 reflection; indexed B2 spots include 200, 211̄, 111̄ and 011̄. (f) and (g) are dark-field TEM images (200 nm scale bars) of 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni respectively, in which κ-carbide appears as fine bright particles; (g) shows brighter cuboidal particles arranged in bands. (h) is a SAED pattern along ZA [011] with a 10 nm⁻¹ scale bar, a single weak spot circled in yellow — the reflection used for the dark-field images. Panels (a) and (e) were not supplied with this group.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph of hot-rolled 28Mn5Ni with a 1 µm scale bar; grains with dislocation substructure and dark stringers, several yellow arrows pointing at fine particles/stringers located at grain boundaries.
Bright-field TEM micrograph of hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni with a 5 µm scale bar (lower magnification than b); yellow arrows mark coarse dark B2 stringers that extend across several γ-grains.

SAED pattern labelled ZA: [011]B2||[011]DO3, 10 nm⁻¹ scale bar. Indexed spots 200, 211̄, 111̄, 011̄; blue circle around the 100 reflection; red circles around additional spots labelled 311(D), 200(D) and 111(D), indicating DO3-type superlattice reflections.
Dark-field TEM image of 28Mn5Ni, 200 nm scale bar; fine bright particles decorating what appear to be grain boundaries and distributed within the dark matrix.
Dark-field TEM image of 15Mn5Ni, 200 nm scale bar; numerous bright, roughly cuboidal particles forming dense banded arrays, clearly more abundant than in (f).
SAED pattern along ZA: [011], 10 nm⁻¹ scale bar; regular array of diffraction spots with one weak spot encircled in yellow, the reflection from which the dark-field images were formed.

observations.observation: Panel (b) is a bright-field TEM micrograph of hot-rolled 28Mn5Ni with a 1 µm scale bar, containing yellow arrows that point to particles/stringers lying on γ-grain boundaries.
Panel (c) is a bright-field TEM micrograph of hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni with a 5 µm scale bar, in which yellow arrows mark coarse dark stringers running across grains.

Panel (d) is a SAED pattern labelled ZA: [011]B2||[011]DO3 with a 10 nm⁻¹ scale bar, showing indexed B2 spots (200, 211̄, 111̄, 011̄) and extra reflections labelled 311(D), 200(D) and 111(D) enclosed in red circles, with the 100 reflection enclosed in a blue circle.
Panels (f) and (g) are dark-field TEM images with 200 nm scale bars, of 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni respectively, in which the imaged second phase appears as bright particles against a dark matrix.
Panel (h) is a SAED pattern taken along ZA: [011] with a 10 nm⁻¹ scale bar, in which one weak diffraction spot is circled in yellow; the dark-field images were formed from this weak spot.
The bright-field images confirm microstructural features such as twins and B2 stringers, with B2 particles of ~300 nm observed at γ-grain boundaries in the 28Mn5Ni alloy.
The dark-field image of 15Mn5Ni (Fig. 3g) shows cuboidal-shaped κ-carbides with sizes in the range 10 to 40 nm.
An orientation relationship of [011]B2 || [011]DO3 exists between the ordered B2 phase and the DO3 phase identified from the SAED pattern in panel (d).
TEM-EDS gives the B2 composition as Fe-10.1Mn-9.7Al-8.3Ni (wt.%) in 15Mn5Ni and Fe-16.3Mn-13.6Al-21.5Ni (wt.%) in 28Mn5Ni, showing higher Ni, Al and Mn in B2 with increasing alloy Mn content.
The volume fraction of κ-carbides is highest in 15Mn5Ni, followed by 28Mn5Ni and 28Mn0Ni, so Ni addition favours κ-carbide formation at constant Mn while increasing Mn suppresses it.
The dark-field images (Fig. 3e-g) show κ-carbides occurring both within the matrix grains and along grain boundaries.
Consistent with the dark-field comparison, the supplied panel (g) of 15Mn5Ni shows a visibly higher density of bright particles than panel (f) of 28Mn5Ni.
